Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1217643, standard_relation equals '=', standard_value not null, standard_relation not null. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
